description: Build a cross-currency macro heatmap from indicator time series and return a matrix with latest values, recent changes, and z-scores. Set mode for a single-pair market cockpit instead. Access: USD needs no API key; other currencies return subscription_required with a subscribe link.

base.description: mode='war_room' only: pair base currency, 3-letter code.

currencies.description: Comma-separated 3-letter currency codes (lowercase preferred). Supported values include: lowercase 3-letter catalogue currency, e.g. usd or eur.

currency.description: mode='war_room' only: spotlight currency. Defaults to usd.

indicator.description: mode='war_room' only: spotlight indicator. Defaults to inflation.

indicators.description: Comma-separated indicator slugs to include in the matrix. Supported values include: catalogue indicator slug, e.g. inflation or policy_rate.

mode.description: heatmap (default) builds the cross-currency matrix. war_room builds one market cockpit: FX sessions, release queue, pair context and risk alerts.

quote.description: mode='war_room' only: pair quote currency. Defaults to usd.

name: macro_heatmap_task
title: Macro Heatmap
